story.headline: Regenerative agriculture can build Southeast Asia’s resilience, if communities take the lead
story.summary: Regenerative agriculture can build Southeast Asia’s resilience, if communities take the lead
story.score_reason: Southeast Asia context, regenerative farming mission-fit

carousel.cover_headline:
Regenerative Farming Works Best
When Communities
Lead It

slides.label: THE REALITY
slides.headline: Climate change is hitting Southeast Asian farms right now
slides.insight: Extreme weather is exposing fragile soils and single-crop farming across the region.

slides.label: WHAT WORKS
slides.headline: Regenerative farming succeeds when built with communities
slides.insight: Farmers test ideas in their own soils. They decide what fits their reality.

slides.label: THE NUMBER
slides.headline: Shared farm work reached **60%** in trained households
slides.insight: When women help shape farm decisions, farms invest more in soil health.

slides.label: WHY WE EXIST
slides.headline: This is exactly why we are building The Human Fuel
slides.insight: A farm built honestly, with community and soil health at its centre.

slides.label: TRY THIS WEEK
slides.headline: Ask where your vegetables actually come from
slides.insight: One question at the market starts a bigger conversation about your food.

carousel.caption:
Regenerative farming works best when communities lead it.

Across Southeast Asia, extreme weather is exposing just how fragile our food systems are. The farms doing better share one thing: communities shape the work, not just experts.

We are building The Human Fuel the same way — honestly, from bare land, with you following every step. What matters most to you in how your food is grown?

Sources: Eco-Business, 2026 (Eco-Business)
